svg.title: Reference deployment topology: 18 clusters in two isolated stacks, with the components in each cluster, Git, Entra ID and the connections inside each stack
svg.text: Reference deployment topology: 18 clusters, two isolated stacks, Git as the only link

Four teams (payments, orders, search, ledger) × three environments (dv, te, pr), plus three platform clusters per stack. Every box inside a cluster is a component; second lines give the namespace or role.
np stack config · platform tag in use
MACHINE IDENTITIES (GITHUB APPS, ONE PER STACK)
opens te and pr promotion PRs
adds pr image digest to the PR
portal, AKS RBAC, vSphere SSO mapping
read by default · PIM to elevate
np portal · Git · pr portal read-only
only dv, te · releases from Git
VM classes · storage policies · VKS releases
ExpressRoute or VPN to the np hub
deny all traffic to the np stack
NO NETWORK PATH · NO SHARED CREDENTIAL, REGISTRY OR SECRET STORE
np-argocd polls: platform tag · platform-nonprod · team-*/nonprod/
pr-argocd polls: platform tag · platform-pr · team-*/pr/
Connections inside each stack (same set in both stacks; nothing crosses between them)
1 Every cluster → its stack's OCM hub on <stack>-platform · 443 outbound (AKS over the hybrid connection)
2 Team clusters, observe, workflow plane → OpenChoreo cluster gateway on <stack>-choreo · WSS 443 outbound
3 <stack>-platform → Supervisor API · 443 · creates and updates VKS clusters
4 <stack>-platform → Azure Resource Manager and Entra ID · 443 · CAPZ and ASO
5 <stack>-platform → private AKS API servers · 443 · CAPI node state, one-time OCM import
6 <stack>-platform (Argo CD) → <stack>-choreo API · 6443 · OpenChoreo config and releases from Git
7 Every cluster → <stack>-observe · OTLP 4317 and remote-write · logs and metrics
8 Every cluster → Key Vault and ACR private endpoints · 443 · secrets and image pulls
9 Workflow plane → Git (clone at commit) and ACR (push) · 443
10 Argo CD → Git · 443 · polling, so Git never connects into a stack
11 GitHub → <stack>-choreo webhook endpoint · 443 · build triggers (optional; GitHub ranges only)
